title: Chapter 1077
text:
The Void Dimension was a chaotic and misty world. The colors were mainly gray and blue, and the space was filled with thick and viscous Void Energy.

Suddenly, the two of them seemed to have been thrown into a blender. The Void Energy around them formed a huge vortex, and Han Xiao and Ames were in the center of the vortex.

Han Xiao raised his vigilance and got into a battle stance. The next moment, a spiritual wave suddenly spread out and swept across the two of them. An ancient and solemn voice sounded in his mind.

"Where did this other-dimensional creature come from? How dare you invade my territory?!"

As the voice fell, a powerful aura emerged out of thin air in their perception. Rays of light flickered around them, and countless figures appeared out of thin air, surrounding the two of them.

The appearances of these creatures were strange, but they all had the characteristics of Void Species and were wearing special armor.

Han Xiao glanced at them and suddenly felt a sense of familiarity.

He was not at all unfamiliar with these strange looking creatures.

The Void Prowlers and Chaos Observers acted as scouts, the Void Hunters, Void Star Pursuers, and Void Walkers acted as roaming scouts. The Void Disciples, Void Executioners, and Magomondo Blades acted as long-range troops. The Void Whisperers, Void Spirits, and Primal Chaos Arcane Energy Bodies were all race options he had encountered during his advancement.

In the middle of the army was the Behemoth Troop. There were ten gigantic Margala Void Behemoths. They were covered in armor and carried countless void creatures. Among them, there were three young Void Dragons. They were ridden by three powerful void creatures.

The leader was a Void Duke. He was about a few hundred meters tall, and his body seemed to be made of solid blue-purple energy. He wore a huge black heavy armor, and he held the reins of the Void Dragon with one hand and a huge black long blade with the other. He looked very imposing … Void Dukes could change their shapes, and at this moment, Zwei was in his humanoid form.

This was a Void Army!

"It seems that we have accidentally intruded into the territory of a Void Duke."

Seeing who it was, Ames frowned.

She was a veteran in the secondary dimension, and this was not the first time she had encountered such a situation.

The Void Dimension was a naturally formed secondary dimension. Its area was extremely vast, and its dimensional attributes were different from that of the main universe. It gave birth to countless void species, and other than growing naturally, they could also strengthen themselves by devouring each other. Thus, it formed a situation where the strong preyed on the weak and the strong preyed on the weak. One by one, the higher void creatures divided their territories, formed armies, and fought against each other.

Void Horde Lords were one of the top-notch void creatures. Every Void Horde Lord had a powerful army under their command. Their goal in war was to devour other Void Lords or Lords. Not only did they use war to fuel war, but they also used the unique characteristics of the Void Dimension to develop special technologies that could be used in the Void Dimension.

Not only did the void creatures kill each other, they were also hostile to other creatures from other dimensions. On one hand, there would occasionally be intruders who would kill them to collect materials. On the other hand, they could use their void bloodline to corrode the intruders and replenish their army. Therefore, the void creatures would not be lenient when encountering visitors from other dimensions.

"They see us as prey."

Countless undisguised malice shrouded the two of them. Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and suddenly released a Beyond Grade A energy wave, which suddenly swept out.

Boom!

A tyrannical aura erupted, and the restless void army in the surroundings froze.

The leader of the Void Horde Lords waved his long blade and released a surprised mental message.

"A Beyond Grade A creature from the main universe?"

The prestige of a Beyond Grade A also resounded throughout the secondary dimensions.

Han Xiao introduced himself. "I'm an ally of the Red Empire, the leader of the Black Star Corps. My nickname is Black Star."

"Black Star? I've never heard of this name. "

The exchange of information between the main universe and the Void Dimension was limited, and most void creatures did not care about the news of the main universe. However, this Void Horde Lord still knew the name of the Red Empire. The prestige of the three Universal Civilizations had spread throughout the secondary dimensions, and the higher life forms of the Void Dimension all had considerable intelligence. Even the Void Horde Lords were not willing to provoke the three Universal Civilizations.

"Outsider, I'm Void Horde Lord Kirkmond. Leave my territory immediately." He pointed his long blade, indicating that he wanted to expel them.

The Beyond Grade A creatures from the main universe were not to be trifled with. Although the Void Dimension had successfully killed some invading Beyond Grade As, those were the deeds of the strongest Void Warlords at the time. The casualties were also heavy, and they were all defeated by the other Void Horde Lords. Kirkmond was only a mid-level Warlord, and he did not want to have a conflict with the Beyond Grade As of the main universe.

Seeing this, Ames also did not want to complicate matters. She patted Han Xiao's waist and said, "Let's go. Don't tangle with them."

Han Xiao glanced at Mo Yang, who was on guard against the Void Army, and suddenly had an idea. He switched to his Void Form, and his entire aura changed.

Seeing this, Kirkmond was shocked.

"You're also a Void?"

"Heh, I'm not a creature from another dimension. I'm one of your kind."

After Han Xiao entered the Beyond Grade A realm, he had transformed into his Exclusive Race. However, his Void Bloodline did not disappear. It had only merged with him.

According to the degree of evolution, Han Xiao's current Void Creature rank was very high. He had already reached the level of a Void Angel, which was similar to a Void Horde Lord.

Kirkmond's attitude changed immediately. There was fear, greed, and at the same time, a desire to curry favor.

If he encountered an ordinary Beyond Grade A, even if he killed the other party, it would not benefit him. However, if they were both Void Creatures, he could devour the other party's bloodline and evolve again.

However, this also meant that the difficulty of killing them would increase greatly. The Void Dimension was the home ground of Void Creatures. The higher the level of the Void Creature, the higher the control of Void Energy. He was like a fish in water here, able to use the endless Void Energy to suppress his opponent. However, now that the other party was also a Void Creature, the advantage of the environment no longer existed.

The power system of the Void Dimension was different from that of the main universe. Void Creatures had all kinds of talents. Through continuous evolution, they stimulated the abilities of their own species to display powerful combat strength. They belonged to the type that could not be replicated by other species, so they could not be called Supers. They could only be regarded as powerful special creatures and were not included in the five major Super systems.

However, Void Creatures could actively learn the Super system of the main universe, and the representatives were well known …

"Do you know Kasuyi?" Kirkmond could not help but ask.

"I'm quite familiar with him." Han Xiao nodded.

Hearing this, Kirkmond's spirit was lifted.

Kasuyi was a super celebrity in the Void Dimension and was recognized as the strongest Void Creature. He had once created a lot of shocking achievements here, subdued a large number of Void Horde Lords and Void Lords, and ruled a large territory in the center of the Void Dimension. No one could compete with him. Although he was usually active in the main universe, his fame in the Void Dimension was unparalleled.

Now, he had met a new Beyond Grade A Void Creature who knew Kasuyi. Kirkmond immediately had the interest to get to know him. After all, he could not come into contact with Kasuyi.

"Black Star, come to my place as a guest." Kirkmond directly sent out an invitation. In the Void Dimension, there were not so many formalities, and his words were all straightforward.

"Okay, let's go take a look." Han Xiao had the same intention. Since he had met this Void Horde Lord, it was a good opportunity to exchange some information. Anyway, he still had a destination for this trip, so he was not afraid of delaying it for a while.

Moreover, there were good things in the Void Dimension. The Void Lord Core that Austin had given him back then had allowed him to purify his bloodline. Although he was already a peak Beyond Grade A, there might be something that could strengthen his Void talent. It was good to try his luck.

Speaking of luck, Han Xiao could not help but think of the [Favored of the Stars] aura on Ames.

Although he did not bring Fu Ding along, Ames' luck did not seem to be bad, and he could take advantage of it.

"This is the road sign. Follow me."

Kirkmond waved his finger and shot out a ball of Void Energy. It contained the coordinates, and it was sent to Han Xiao.

The next moment, the surrounding Void Lords instantly flickered and disappeared from the Void Dimension. However, there were no creatures that could fly normally, and all of them had mastered the traditional skill of Void Travel.

Seeing this, Ames shook her head helplessly. "You actually exposed your identity as a Void Creature. When Hella and I were training in the secondary dimensions, we did not dare to do so. Otherwise, we would not have been able to return."

"That's because you're skilled." Han Xiao laughed.

Secondary dimensions were still dangerous for normal Beyond Grade As, but peak Beyond Grade As were not afraid.

The two of them followed the road signs and traveled through the Void Dimension, quickly arriving at Kirkmond's base.

This was a magnificent city suspended in space. Its entire body had a crystalline texture, and the base was translucent. One could see the bright energy core within, surrounded by dense grayish-blue Void Energy.

In the Void Dimension, natural materials were extremely rare. Generally, they were refined using special techniques to transform the Void Energy into crystals. To build such a city, the expenditure was extremely huge.

The huge city was filled with bases. Rather than calling it a city, it was more like a large military camp. The two of them arrived at the main hall in the center of the city, and Kirkmond welcomed them in.

He shrunk his body to the same size as Han Xiao, and after sitting down, he could not wait to ask, "Black Star, where were you born?"

This was Pan Dao 'er. He had thought that Han Xiao was a native Void Creature. Han Xiao did not hide and explained that he was a Void Creature that had been living in the main universe.

The two of them chatted and exchanged information. Han Xiao introduced the situation of the main universe, and Kirkmond talked about the situation of the Void Dimension.

In his previous life, the players' understanding of the secondary dimensions was limited, and they only came into contact with them in the later stages of the game. Furthermore, many secondary dimensions did not have the habit of recording history, and Han Xiao also lacked information about the current Void Dimension.

After chatting for a while, Han Xiao had a general understanding of the current situation of the Void Dimension. It could be abbreviated as one super strong and many strong.

Kasuyi was the strongest and occupied the central area, but he had no intention of unifying the Void Dimension, nor did he have the ability to do so. The other powerful Void Lords kept popping up like bamboo shoots after the rain, dividing their territories and killing each other. Other than that, there were also many chaotic areas like wild forests. There was no order, and new Void Creatures were constantly breeding and freely killing each other.

After chatting for a while, Kirkmond finally asked about Han Xiao's intentions.

"I don't have a goal. I just plan to travel around the secondary dimensions. My first stop is the Void Dimension, and I happened to meet you." Han Xiao spread his hands.

Hearing this, Kirkmond thought for a while and said, "Since you have nothing to do, do me a favor."

The Void Dimension did not care about formalities. Although it was the first time they had met, Kirkmond did not hold back.

"What do you want me to help you with?" Han Xiao was curious.

"I've always wanted to get rid of Bagdora. He's also a Void Lord, and his territory is close to mine. I've fought hundreds of battles with him. With your help, I can completely get rid of him, devour his core, and take over his army."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Then what can you give me in return?"

"I'll give you half of the Void Life Cores left on the battlefield. Whatever Void Dimension specialties you want, I'll find them for you." Kirkmond waved his hand. There was no need for negotiation skills here, and he directly gave his bottom line. "Moreover, you can obtain my friendship. If you need help in the main universe, you can open a Void Passage, and I'll bring my army to help you fight."

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyes moved.

When he had evolved into a [Void Pathfinder], he had obtained a talent called [Void Passage]. Its effect was to temporarily open the door to the Void Dimension.

All along, he had rarely used this ability because the void creatures he summoned could not differentiate between friend and foe. If he could reach an agreement with Kirkmond, he could use this ability to summon a Void Army to fight for him.

It was the same for Kasuyi. He could use his talent to summon a Void Army under him, and that was how his nickname 'Void Overlord' came about. However, he rarely used this ability now because his main body was too strong. Most of the time, there was no need for him to summon his underlings.

Although he was not a summoner, this talent could achieve the effect of summoning.

At this moment, a notification popped up on Han Xiao's interface.

You have triggered the mission [Void Lord's War Employment]!

Mission Introduction: Void Lord Kirkmond has taken a fancy to your combat strength and hopes to hire you to fight for him and eliminate his enemy.

Mission Requirements: Defeat Void Lord Bagdora's army.

Reward: 120 billion EXP, + 3,000 Faction – Kirkmond Favorability, 1 Character Summon Card.

Bonus Reward: Start the milestone mission [Void Conqueror].

[Void Conqueror]: Milestone Completion Condition: Destroy 8 Void Overlords (Void Creatures of the same level). At the same time, at least 4 Void Overlords' Faction Favorability has reached Respect (3000 Faction Favorability). Rewards will be given after completion.

Milestone Reward: If you have a void-related ability, the base effect will increase slightly. You will receive 500-2,000 Free Attribute Points, + 1 Legendary Point, + 20 Void Creatures' Favorability toward you, and + 1 God's Trait Transformation Point (Can only be triggered by activating the talent [God's Trait Transformation]).

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Woah, this reward is not bad. I can actually get a God's Trait Transformation Point. I thought that after creating a Universal Treasure, I would have to wait until my Promotion to get a new point.

Looking at the introduction, only Beyond Grade A God's Trait Transformation Level would trigger this bonus point reward. If other people accepted this mission, they would not be able to see this message.

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed.

Not only was there a mission, but he could also get a large number of void specialties that Kirkmond had promised. This deal was worth doing. To Han Xiao, it was just picking up his old profession and becoming a war mercenary.

"Okay, I promise you." Han Xiao nodded and smiled. "But let's not do it now. I still have some things to do. Let's do it when I'm back."

He decided to accept this employment. However, the focus of this trip was the Holy Light Particle. He planned to get it first and return to help Kirkmond fight after he was done with his business. This was not something that could not be discussed. In his eyes, the priority was clear.

"No problem!" Kirkmond was overjoyed and agreed immediately.

After all, they had been fighting for so many years. He was not in a hurry.

On the other side, Ames was not interested in the conversation between the two of them. She took out the resurrection token and played with it in her hands. She had also received this gift from Hella.

At this time, Kirkmond glanced at her subconsciously. Suddenly, he paused and stared at the resurrection token.

"Hmm?" Ames raised her eyebrows. She closed her fingers and grabbed the resurrection token. "What are you looking at?"

"Oh, can you show me the thing in your hands? I feel a familiar aura. "Kirkmond was not polite at all, and his tone was filled with doubt.

Han Xiaoxin took out his own resurrection token and asked, "I have the same thing. Does it have a familiar aura?"

"Yes, but it's very weak. Can you show it to me and let me identify it carefully?" Kirkmond nodded.

Han Xiao thought for a while and tossed the resurrection token to Kirkmond.

Kirkmond's palm transformed into energy that enveloped the resurrection token. He sensed it for a while and said uncertainly, "I seem to have felt a similar energy in a secondary dimension before …"

Han Xiao's expression changed.

The resurrection token had the effect of [Revival of Death Resistance]. According to his deduction, this was a new ability that Hella had developed. With her delicate control over her Esper Ability, she had fused Aurora's life energy with her own Necromancy Energy to form a new energy.

Hella had once said that when she established the Distanceless Life Link with Aurora, the difficulty she encountered came from a special secondary dimension that absorbed most of the energy transmitted between the two of them. Hella had originally planned to investigate it, but she did not come this time.

So, I coincidentally met the target that Hella was looking for?

Han Xiao could not help but turn to look at Ames.

Compared to touching Ding, touching you seems to be better …
